newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept electricity demand falls 3.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept electricity demand falls 3.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Demand for electricity supplied by nine key Japanese power utilities in September fell 3.7 percent from a year earlier to 67.2 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said on Friday.
Consumption by households and offices decreased in September, mainly because of a drop in use of air conditioners.
Large-lot industrial demand in September increased by 2.4 percent from a year earlier, increasing year-on-year for the first time in two months.
Growth stemmed from an increase in demand from steel makers and makers of electrical and transport machinery.
